name: Scandinavian Defense
description: A direct Black repertoire against e4 that teaches immediate central counterplay and simple development after White reacts.

branches.title: Main Line: Challenge e4
branches.description: Learn the default Scandinavian idea against 1.e4.

moves.title: White claims center
moves.explanation: White controls d5 and f5. Black should challenge this center immediately.

moves.title: Strike with d5
moves.explanation: d5 attacks e4 at once. This is the core Scandinavian idea: meet the center before it grows.

hints: The target response in this branch is d5.
Use the highlighted move and keep the plan simple.

branches.title: Recapture Carefully
branches.description: If White takes on d5, recapture and expect to lose a tempo to Nc3.

moves.title: White captures
moves.explanation: White removes the d5 pawn and opens the queen file.

moves.title: Recommended: recapture
moves.explanation: Qxd5 restores material. The beginner lesson is to recapture, then accept that the queen may move again after Nc3.

hints: The target response in this branch is Qxd5.

branches.title: Keep Development Simple
branches.description: If White protects e4 instead of capturing, develop normally.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Nf6 develops and adds pressure to e4. Do not move the queen for no reason.

hints: The target response in this branch is Nf6.
